scene: A phone vlog on a sunny open-air station platform on the morning of a travel day; a few people wait further along and an announcement mumbles far off. Luna holds the phone at arm's length and talks to it; Timo stands upright just behind her with a stopwatch hanging round his neck.
context: An eight-second comedy sketch played by two close friends on a sports trip. It must sound like two real people talking, quick and natural, never like an advert or a narrator. LUNA, about 25, is cheerful and quick; she is proud of her friend, who times their whole travel day to the minute, and she says so brightly to her vlog; then she is honestly worried when he says they are late. TIMO, about 30, is slow, dry and proud; he never raises his voice; he reports the delay gravely, as a plain fact, and then tells the camera, flat and level, that the delay is this video. His last two words come after a pause and are just as flat: no joke in his voice at all. They answer each other fast.
lines: [bright, proud of him, to the camera] Travel day! Timo's timing every minute.
[grave, low, a plain report] We're four minutes behind.
[worried, turning to him, quick] Why? What happened?
[flat and level, to the camera, a plain fact] This video.
[after a pause, just as flat, a little quieter] Five now.

L.audio_profile: A cheerful woman of 25 with a bright, warm, quick voice; standing on a sunny station platform on the morning of a trip, speaking into her phone held at arm's length; natural and unpolished, like a friend filming a vlog.

T.audio_profile: A tall, calm man of 30 with a low, dry, casual voice; slow, proud, deadpan; he stands just behind her shoulder on the platform with a stopwatch round his neck, completely serious about the schedule, and never raises his voice.
